title: Gone by noon
hook_text: Sold out by noon. Every day.

shots.visual: A dark blistered sourdough loaf on a flour-dusted wooden counter; a serrated knife slices through and the open crumb is revealed as the slice falls.
shots.on_screen_text: Sold out by noon. Every day.

shots.visual: Rows of butter croissants on a cooling rack, layers catching low morning light, steam rising from the tray.
A paper bag of warm bread being set down on the counter beside a takeaway coffee, flour prints on the bag, soft window light.
shots.on_screen_text: Grab it on the way in.

shots.visual: The bakery's wooden front door opening onto a quiet morning street, warm light spilling out, empty shelves glimpsed inside.

variants: If you get here after 11, it's gone.
This is what 48 hours tastes like.
